newsitem.title: USA: Court upholds partial stay on FCC phone rules.
newsitem.headline: Court upholds partial stay on FCC phone rules.

text.p: A U.S. court on Tuesday put on hold key provisions of a landmark federal rule designed to break open the nation's local phone monopolies to competition while it considers a court challenge to the measure.

The federal appeals court here "stayed," or suspended, the pricing and "pick-and-choose" elements of the Federal Communications Commission's "interconnection" order aimed at opening the $100 billion local phone market to long-distance carriers, cable-television operators and others. The stay is in effect until the court rules on the challenge some time next year.
